app.err_grab_busy: Could not register the shortcut “{combo}”: another program is using it.
app.err_hotkey_busy: The shortcut “{combo}” is used by another program (for example, Clip2net). Close it or change the key in Settings.

app.gnome_hotkey_failed: Could not set the shortcut in GNOME: {error}
app.record_hotkey: Screen recording: press {hotkey}. After you log out and back in, the “Record video” button will open the screen recording window by itself.
app.record_snipping: Screen recording: open Snipping Tool and choose video recording
app.autostart_store_user: Starting ClipSD with Windows is turned off in Windows Settings. Turn ClipSD on in the “Startup” page that has opened.
app.store_description: Screenshots with an editor, text recognition and translation
app.store_welcome_sub: Capture an area of the screen: {hotkey} or a click on the ClipSD icon next to the clock.
app.store_startup_note: You can turn it off at any time: ClipSD settings, section “{section}”.
app.ext_relogin_text: For ClipSD to see all windows, log out once and log back in: this is how GNOME loads the extension. Save your work in open programs before you log out.
app.ext_old_title: An old ClipSD extension was found
app.ext_old_text: The window list works through a GNOME extension. An old version of it, installed by hand earlier, was found and ClipSD cannot update it. Click Replace: the old version will be turned off and set aside (its folder is kept), and the current one will be put in its place.
app.ext_replaced_text: Log out and log in again so the extension starts working. Save your work in open programs before logging out. Until then the hotkeys work through a backup method.
app.ext_failed_text: The current extension keeps working. Reason: {reason}
app.ext_no_source: this ClipSD build has no extension files
app.ext_userext_off_title: Extensions are turned off in GNOME
app.ext_userext_off_text: The ClipSD extension was not updated: all user extensions are turned off in GNOME, so logging in again would change nothing. Turn them on in the Extensions app (the switch at the top of the window) and press “Update” again.
app.ext_unsupported_title: This GNOME version is not supported yet
app.ext_unsupported_text: The ClipSD extension works in GNOME 45-50, you have GNOME {version}. The window list will be incomplete, everything else works as usual.
